{{Short description|Serbian physicist and academic}}
'''Aleksandar Despić''' (January 6, 1927&ndash;April 7, 2005) was a [[Serbia]]n [[physicist]] and academic. Despić received his PhD degree from the [[Imperial College of Science and Technology]], [[London]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://sanu.digitalcube.rs/rs/darodavci/aleksandar-despic/aleksandar-despic|title=Збирка одликовања архива САНУ|website=sanu.digitalcube.rs|language=sr|access-date=2019-05-12}}{{Dead link|date=June 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> He was a professor at the Faculty of Technology, [[University of Belgrade]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.blic.rs/kultura/vesti/preminuo-akademik-aleksandar-despic/vvvn81s|title=Preminuo akademik Aleksandar Despić|last=arhiva|first=blic|website=Blic.rs|language=sr|access-date=2019-05-12}}</ref> and his scientific interests include fundamental and applied [[electrochemistry]]. He was the President of the [[Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts]] from 1994 to 1998.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.vreme.com/arhiva_html/435/14.html|title=SANU|website=www.vreme.com|access-date=2019-05-12}}</ref>

==Selected works==
# A.R.Despic, K.I.Popov, Transport Controlled Deposition and Dissolution of Metals, Modern Aspects of Electrochemistry, Plenum Press, New York, 1972, Vol.7, Ch.4
# A.R.Despic, Deposition and Dissolution of Metals and Alloys, part B: Mechanism, Kinetics, Texture and Morphology, in: Comprehensive Treatise on Electrochemιstry, ed. J.O.M.Bockris, B.E.Conway, E.Yeager, Plenum Press, New York, 1983, Vol.7, Ch.7b
# A.Despic, V.Parkhutik, Electrochemistry of Aluminium in Aqueous Solutions and Physics of Its Anodic Oxides, in: Modern Aspects of Electrochemistry, ed. J.O.M.Bockris, R.E.White, B.E.Conway, Plenum Press, New York, 1989, Vol.20, Ch.6.
# A.R.Despic, The use of aluminium in energy conversion and storage, in: Chemistry and Energy - I, ed.C.A.C.Sequeira, Sintra (Portugal), 1990. (Materials science monographs, 65.)
# A.R.Despic, V.D.Jovic, Electrochemical Deposition and Dissolution of Alloys and Metal Composites - Fundamentals Aspects, Modern Aspects of Electrochemistry, Plenum Press, New York, 1995, Vol.27, Ch.2.
